verdict.rationale: USPTO claims it will 'guide you through every step of the application process' and offers a 'file a patent application on your own' path. It also provides a quick IP-eligibility assessment, 'before filing' search advice, application-timeline tables, and an interactive training-mode simulation, all aimed at non-lawyer filers. However, much of the pack consists of form and task listings (TEAS forms, Statement of Use, extensions), and the plain-language explainers themselves are only claimed, not shown. Missing for 10: actual step-by-step explainer content written for non-lawyers, evidence that trademark guidance is equally plain-language, and independent or hands-on confirmation that founders can follow it without counsel.
